description: Clean-room AOB signature database for WMPF flue.dll hook points. Each entry captures a cross-version byte pattern around a reviewed function entry point.
source: Clean-room extracted and uniquely matched against reviewed official WMPF v19977 and v20079 flue.dll modules.

verification.runtimeVerification: WMPF v19977 passed the full live semantic gate. WMPF v20079 passed profile generation, SHA-256 binding, offset bounds, production hook attachment, ready, and explicit detach; its mini-program semantic gate remains pending.

cdpFilter.description: SendToClientFilter — CDP filter function. The pattern matched exactly once in reviewed v19977 and v20079 flue.dll modules. Hook attaches onLeave, reads input pointer+8, and patches value 6→0.

loadStart.description: AppletIndexContainer::OnLoadStart — mini-program load entry. The wildcarded call displacement keeps one unique entry-point match in reviewed v19977 and v20079 flue.dll modules. Hook attaches onEnter, reads the rcx→scene chain, and patches whitelisted scenes to 1101.

versionProfiles.runtimeVerification: Full live semantic gate: AppService selection, evaluate, bound breakpoint, trace and request hooks, Network body, replay, reconnect, detach, and evidence export.
Profile generation, SHA-256 binding, offset bounds, production FridaRuntimeAdapter hook attachment, ready, and explicit detach. Mini-program semantic gates were not run.
